title: English Practice Quiz 0887
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A purchase order is generally used to:
options: formally request or authorise a purchase
questions.explanation: A purchase order documents an authorised purchase request.

questions.question: A stocktake is the process of:
questions.explanation: A stocktake checks actual stock quantities against records.

questions.question: When delivered goods do not match the order, you should:
options: record the discrepancy and notify the responsible person
questions.explanation: Documenting the mismatch supports correction and accountability.

questions.question: A reorder level indicates when:
questions.explanation: The reorder level triggers replenishment before stock runs out.

questions.question: An invoice is a document that typically requests:
options: payment for supplied goods or services
questions.explanation: An invoice states the amount due for goods or services.

questions.question: Why should inventory records be updated promptly?
questions.explanation: Timely updates keep stock information reliable.

questions.question: A supplier quotation usually provides:
options: prices and terms for proposed goods or services
questions.explanation: A quotation outlines proposed pricing and conditions.

questions.question: Which practice reduces duplicate purchasing?
questions.explanation: Checking stock first prevents unnecessary repeat orders.

questions.question: 'Back order' means an item:
options: is temporarily unavailable and will be supplied later
questions.explanation: A back-ordered item is pending future supply.

questions.question: A delivery note is useful for confirming:
questions.explanation: A delivery note lists the items supplied with a delivery.
